tasks.title: Validate Mobile Responsive Design
tasks.description:
Validate that the calculator application is fully responsive on mobile devices:

1. Run the test suite:
   - Execute: npm test
   - Verify all responsive tests pass in:
     * src/components/Button.test.tsx (responsive design tests)
     * src/components/Calculator.test.tsx (mobile responsive design tests)
     * src/components/Display.test.tsx (responsive design tests)

2. Visual validation:
   - Start dev server: npm run dev
   - Note the server URL from output
   - Use Playwright to take screenshots at multiple viewport sizes:
     * Mobile: 375x667 (iPhone SE), 414x896 (iPhone XR)
     * Tablet: 768x1024 (iPad)
     * Desktop: 1920x1080
   - Save screenshots to .eunomia/screenshots/qa/
   - Stop dev server

3. Verify in screenshots:
   - Calculator fits within viewport (no horizontal overflow)
   - Buttons are touch-friendly (minimum 44px)
   - Text is readable at all sizes
   - Proper spacing and layout at each breakpoint
acceptance_criteria: Screenshots captured for mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports
No horizontal overflow at any viewport size
Buttons meet 44px minimum touch target on mobile
Calculator layout is correct at all tested sizes
